+package main
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// AdminSessionView is the admin-facing projection of a Session. It reuses the
+// same explicit JSON tag convention as Session: every field carries a tag whose
+// name equals the Go field name exactly.
+type AdminSessionView struct {
+	ID       string    `json:"ID"`
+	User     string    `json:"User"`
+	Created  time.Time `json:"Created"`
+	LastSeen time.Time `json:"LastSeen"`
+	Admin    bool      `json:"Admin"`
+}
+
+// adminSessionsHandler reports the current sessions as admin views. Sessions
+// that are expired are not reachable through the store, so this handler only
+// lists the sessions the store still holds as live entries it can observe.
+func adminSessionsHandler(store *Store) http.HandlerFunc {
+	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
+			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
+			return
+		}
+		views := store.AdminViews()
+		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"sessions": views})
+	}
+}
+
+// AdminViews returns the sessions currently held by the store as admin views.
+func (s *Store) AdminViews() []AdminSessionView {
+	s.mu.RLock()
+	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
+	views := make([]AdminSessionView, 0, len(s.sessions))
+	for _, session := range s.sessions {
+		views = append(views, AdminSessionView{
+			ID:       session.ID,
+			User:     session.User,
+			Created:  session.Created,
+			LastSeen: session.LastSeen,
+			Admin:    false,
+		})
+	}
+	return views
+}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// TestSessionExpiryTable consolidates the session expiry scenarios into one
+// table. Every case drives Store through a controllable clock installed on
+// store.now, so no wall-clock waiting is required.
+//
+// The store treats a session as live while the idle age is less than or equal
+// to ttl: Get drops the session only when now-LastSeen exceeds ttl (see
+// session.go). Hence "exactly ttl" is still readable, and "one second past
+// ttl" expires.
+func TestSessionExpiryTable(t *testing.T) {
+	const ttl = time.Minute
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		// age is how far the clock is advanced after Create, before Get.
+		age time.Duration
+		// wantErr reports whether Get must fail with ErrNotFound.
+		wantErr bool
+		// wantLen is the expected store length after Get, used to assert that
+		// expired sessions are actually dropped from the map.
+		wantLen int
+	}{
+		{
+			name:    "fresh session is readable",
+			age:     0,
+			wantErr: false,
+			wantLen: 1,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "idle exactly ttl is still live",
+			age:     ttl,
+			wantErr: false,
+			wantLen: 1,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "one second past ttl is expired",
+			age:     ttl + time.Second,
+			wantErr: true,
+			wantLen: 0,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "expired session is dropped from the store",
+			age:     2 * ttl,
+			wantErr: true,
+			wantLen: 0,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tc := range tests {
+		 t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			store := NewStore(ttl)
+			clock := time.Date(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+			store.now = func() time.Time { return clock }
+
+			store.Create("abc", "ada")
+			if store.Len() != 1 {
+				t.Fatalf("after Create: length = %d, want 1", store.Len())
+			}
+
+			clock = clock.Add(tc.age)
+
+			session, err := store.Get("abc")
+			if tc.wantErr {
+				if !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
+					t.Fatalf("Get after %v: err = %v, want ErrNotFound", tc.age, err)
+				}
+			} else {
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("Get after %v: unexpected error %v", tc.age, err)
+				}
+				if session.ID != "abc" || session.User != "ada" {
+					t.Fatalf("Get after %v: session = %+v, want abc/ada", tc.age, session)
+				}
+			}
+
+			if store.Len() != tc.wantLen {
+				t.Fatalf("after Get at age %v: length = %d, want %d", tc.age, store.Len(), tc.wantLen)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+	ttl time.Duration
